SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS execution_count
FROM orderexecutions AS oe
JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark
JOIN users AS u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink
WHERE oe.expirespot >= '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496'
  AND oe.expirespot <= '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533'
GROUP BY u.acctscope;

assumptions.assumption: The expiry values are stored as consistently formatted timestamp text, so inclusive text comparisons preserve chronological order.
